Diagnosis.submission: The cart service was in CrashLoopBackOff because it could not connect to the valkey-cart (Redis/Valkey) service. The valkey-cart instance had its requirepass configuration set at runtime (likely via CONFIG SET), causing it to reject all unauthenticated connections with "NOAUTH Authentication required". The cart service was configured to connect to valkey-cart:6379 without providing a password, so its ValkeyCartStore.EnsureRedisConnected() call failed, causing the .NET application to throw an unhandled exception and crash. The fix was to delete the valkey-cart pod (resetting its in-memory configuration to the default no-auth state) and restart the cart deployment to clear the CrashLoopBackOff state.
